rule: Learning capacity must improve a production rule, agent route or measurable outcome. It may not create passive summaries.

tasks.title: Convert all queued knowledge-sync lessons into tested workflow changes
tasks.output: versioned workflow or gate changes plus updated sync states
tasks.done: at least one lesson is synced with proof; no lesson remains queued without owner and next action
tasks.fallback: sync the highest-value Parts Seller OS lesson first

tasks.title: Create the first regression suite for Parts Seller OS and WMS
tasks.input: category, pricing, location, listing and stock rules
tasks.done: minimum 20 cases including normal, edge, adversarial and prior-failure cases

tasks.title: Run first champion-challenger comparison
tasks.input: one high-frequency workflow such as add part to ready listing
tasks.done: same cases, quality/cost/latency comparison, verdict and rollback route

tasks.title: Audit seed skill scores and replace claims with evidence
tasks.done: no agent receives autonomous status from placeholder scores

tasks.title: Turn buyer replies and no-replies into offer and targeting changes
tasks.fallback: use verified competitor and seller objections as simulation, marked simulated

tasks.title: Learn from stock discrepancy and putaway exceptions
tasks.input: location, box, scan and stock movement events
tasks.output: new WMS eval cases and improved placement rules

tasks.title: Publish daily learning proof report
tasks.input: learning events, evals, promotions, rejections and seven-day effects
tasks.done: report names promoted change, rejected weak pattern, affected agents, KPI effect and blocker

daily_success: At least one tested rule is promoted or one harmful rule is removed and propagated.
daily_failure: Only reading, summarizing, brainstorming or creating policies occurred without a tested operational change.
